entities.name: Sergey Filimonov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sergey Yuryevich Filimonov is a Kazakhstani weightlifter who competed in the Men's 77 kg at the 2004 Summer Olympics and won the silver medal with 372.5 kg in total.
